profile:
## Evan

**Identity/family/relationships:** Evan is a parent with a son and another child expected with his partner. He married a Canadian woman in December 2023; they had met in Canada in late July/early August. His family is his “rock,” and he and Sam are supportive friends.

**Work/studies:** Lost his job in an October 2023 downsizing and was seeking work by November. Took watercolor classes in August 2023; no other classes then.

**Interests/activities:** Watercolor and other painting (especially landscapes), hiking, road trips, nature, skiing, snowboarding, ice skating, biking, kayaking, swimming, gym/weightlifting, walking, yoga, driving, reading, and caring for a bonsai. Painting helps him relax, process emotions, and express himself without words. He enjoys beaches, mountains, lakes, sunsets, and adventure.

**Health/values/goals:** Has worked on health through diet, walking, exercise, vegetables and fruit, and fewer sugary/processed foods. Values consistency, small steps, family, resilience, and appreciating life’s little things. Ginger snaps are a weakness, though he limited himself to two daily in January 2024.

**Possessions:** New Prius (which broke down in December 2023), previously repaired and sold an old Prius; gym membership, fitness watch, bonsai, and a gifted 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar. No pets mentioned.

**Timeline:** May 2023, Rockies family hike; May 20–21, Jasper/Icefields Parkway trip. July 2023, Banff skiing and Rocky Mountains road trip. August, Canada vacation and watercolor classes; son injured ankle. August 25, knee injury; later physical therapy. October, basketball knee injury and job loss. November, hospital scare proved harmless; planned beach visit with Sam. December, Prius breakdown, partner’s pregnancy, son’s bike injury, marriage, and minor mountain-trip car accident. January 2024, honeymoon plans for Canada in February; tried snowshoeing.

## Sam

**Identity/relationships:** Sam’s family is a major source of support. Sam and Evan encourage each other through health and life challenges.

**Work/studies:** Took a cooking class for healthier meals and became a Weight Watchers coach in November 2023.

**Interests/activities:** Hiking, painting, sketching, drawing, journaling, creative writing, cooking, kayaking, running, yoga, beach/country walks, car rides, nature, and possibly skiing. Writing helps Sam understand feelings; nature and driving are calming.

**Health/goals:** Weight-related health concerns followed check-ups in May, August, and October 2023; gastritis caused an emergency-room visit on October 14–15. Sam reduced soda/candy, tried healthier diets, meal planning, exercise schedules, and low-impact activity, while struggling with cravings, discomfort, stress, and motivation. Values patience, small victories, positivity, and progress over perfection.

**Possessions/no pets:** New phone with navigation problems; no pets mentioned.

**Timeline:** Childhood: special long hike with father at age ten. May 2023, considered painting. August 21, began a diet/exercise routine; August 14, cooked salmon and vegetables. September, shared health progress and planned painting with Evan. October, began drawing and writing; tried/considered kayaking at Lake Tahoe; gastritis diagnosis. November, became a Weight Watchers coach. December 29, hiked with friends. January 2024, planned diet, workouts, doctor visit, yoga and nature walks; enjoyed morning runs.
